Corporate Booking Process

Streamlined workflow designed for busy corporate decision-makers.

1

Initial Inquiry

Fill RFP form, email, or WhatsApp with event date, location, guest count, budget range, and objectives. We respond within 4 hours with preliminary availability.

→
2

Consultation Call

30-45 minute video/phone call with decision-makers. Understand goals, audience profile, brand values. Discuss packages, customization, technical logistics.

→
3

Custom Proposal

Detailed PDF proposal (delivered within 3-5 days) with 2-3 package options, line-item pricing, performance flow, technical requirements, sample media, references.

→
4

Site Visit (Optional)

For events ₹2L+, our technical team visits venue to assess stage, sound, lighting. Coordinate with venue management. Finalize production details.

5

Contract Signature

Performance agreement outlining deliverables, payment schedule, cancellation policy. Vendor registration forms completed. Insurance certificates provided.

→
6

Pre-Event Coordination

2-4 weeks before: Rehearsal video shared (custom content), timeline confirmation, technical rider sent to venue, travel finalized, final headcount confirmed.

→
7

Event Execution

Team arrives 3+ hours early for setup, soundcheck, dress rehearsal. Performance delivered as contracted. Professional conduct throughout event.

→
8

Post-Event Follow-Up

Invoice submission within 7 days, photos/videos shared, feedback survey sent, testimonial request (if positive). Discussion of future collaboration opportunities.

⏰ Booking Timeline: Major annual events (200+ attendees) book 3-6 months ahead. Peak season (Oct-March) needs 6+ months. Smaller events (50-100) can be arranged 4-6 weeks out, subject to availability.

Logistics & Technical Specifications

Technical Requirements

Sound System

  • Small events (50-100): We provide portable PA
  • Medium events (100-300): Coordinate with venue system
  • Large events (300+): Professional rental (quoted separately)

Stage Size

  • Minimum: 12×10 feet for 3-5 artists
  • Recommended: 20×15 feet for 6-10 artists
  • Ideal: 30×20 feet for full production (12+ artists)

Power Requirements

  • Standard 230V AC power supply
  • 2-4 power outlets (15 amp capacity)
  • Generator backup for outdoor events

Artist Requirements

Green Room

  • Private space for 8-15 people
  • Chairs, mirrors, power outlets
  • Refreshments (water, tea, snacks)
  • Located near stage access

Travel & Accommodation

  • Within 50km of Pushkar: No additional charge
  • 50-200km: ₹15,000-30,000 (team dependent)
  • 200km+: Flight/train + hotel (2-star minimum)
  • Multi-day: Accommodation for entire team

Lighting

  • Basic: Venue house lights sufficient
  • Enhanced: 4-6 moving heads + wash lights
  • Premium: Full rig with follow spots (coordinated)

Corporate Client FAQ

How far in advance should we book?

For major annual events (200+ attendees), book 3-6 months ahead. Conferences during peak season (Oct-March) need 6+ months. Smaller events (50-100) can be arranged with 4-6 weeks notice, subject to availability.

Do you have liability insurance for venue performances?

Yes. We carry public liability insurance (₹10 lakh coverage) for all commercial performances. Certificate provided upon request for venue management or procurement teams. We also handle vendor registration paperwork.

Can you work with our AV vendor and event management company?

Absolutely. We’re experienced collaborating with technical teams and event agencies. We submit our technical rider in advance (stage, sound, lighting specifications) and coordinate seamlessly with your vendors throughout.

What if a performer falls ill on event day?

For large events (₹2L+ budget), we maintain backup performers on standby. For critical performances, we have a roster of 50+ professional artists we can call upon with 24-hour notice. Zero disruption guarantee.

Can you integrate our company branding into the performance?

Yes! We’ve done product launch integrations, company anthem performances, brand color-coordinated costumes, and messaging woven into hosting segments. Share your vision during consultation—we’ll customize accordingly.

Do you provide GST invoices and handle vendor registration?

Yes. We’re GST-registered (provide GSTIN upon request) and issue proper tax invoices. We complete vendor registration forms, submit PAN/GST certificates, and work within your procurement process timelines.

What’s your cancellation policy for corporate bookings?

Cancellations 90+ days before event: 80% refund. 60-90 days: 50% refund. 30-60 days: 25% refund. Within 30 days: deposit retained (as artists are blocked). Force majeure exceptions apply with documentation.

Can you perform for multi-city corporate roadshows?

Yes! We’ve executed 5-city tours for product launches. We can provide the same consistent team across locations OR coordinate with our network of quality-assured artists in each city (we vet all performers).

How do you handle international delegate audiences?

We provide bilingual hosting (English + Hindi), cultural context explanations, and adjust repertoire for universal appeal. Our team has performed for 50+ nationalities—we understand cross-cultural entertainment nuances.

What if our event runs late and you need to adjust timing?

We build 30-minute buffers into schedules for corporate events. If delays exceed 1 hour, we may need to shorten performance or discuss overtime charges (₹10,000-20,000/hour depending on team size).

Do you provide post-event metrics or reports?

We can coordinate with your team on attendee satisfaction surveys (entertainment-specific questions). For social media content, we provide performance photos/videos within 48 hours for your corporate channels.

What’s included vs. additional costs?

Included: All artist fees, costumes, instruments, basic sound (small events), setup/breakdown, travel within 50km, consultation, day-of coordination. Additional: Long-distance travel (50km+), accommodation (multi-day), large venue technical rentals, videography add-ons.

Krishna Music School teaches harmonium, Indian singing, bhajan and kirtan, Hindustani classical vocal and tabla. Classes are live and one-to-one, online worldwide or in person at the historic Rangji Temple in Pushkar, Rajasthan, India. Founded in 2008 by musician and teacher Vini Devda.
